all_assigned: All lineage x case x arm assignments, including failures, rejected edits, no-op artifacts and abstentions; admission failure deploys unchanged parent with zero target gain/harm and joint success false

budgets.training_timeout_policy: Failure retains assigned main seed; no substitute seed

candidate_selection: Frozen grid; calibration protected cap first, then target gain minus protected harm, then smaller harm and larger gain; first index tie

cases.selection: fixed before pilot; no official test opened
largest aggregated cross-queue confusion over pilot development; distinct truth labels, >=2 pilot lineages err, label-order tie break

cost_scope: Acquisition/preparation, full parent encoder training, all proposal options and selection, exact verification, native/binary64 execution, storage/export and rollback are charged separately; wall times are CPU/environment estimates, not operational savings
decision_rule: Lowest-index argmax original-intent/specialist output followed by fixed derived queue mapping; overlay sees predicted code, never truth
designation: resource-capped estimation; main is heldout evaluation but not a sufficiently powered confirmation

encoder_training.epoch_selection: highest development original-intent accuracy, earliest tie

evaluation_missingness: Any missing target/protected evaluation or failed lineage is retained, joint success false; sensitivity imputes missing gain [-1,+1], harm [-1,+1], success [0,1]
exact_contract: Numerical nullspace is diagnostic; hard lane additionally requires exact dyadic zero anchor residual on the realized float32 endpoint
freeze_kind: local executable source and benchmark protocol, not externally preregistered
inference: Two-sided 95% paired Student t over six full lineage means, conditional on fixed requests; independently seeded exact-group crossed bootstrap is a sensitivity estimate. No population-editor inference; few-lineage uncertainty remains
lineage_unit: Complete encoder and head initialized/trained independently from scratch; preprocessing and request sets shared across lineages

margin_rationale.maximum_protected_harm: Project feasibility cap: at most one percentage point net protected queue error increase, with decision flip and per-intent harms reported separately. Improvements cannot conceal those diagnostics.
margin_rationale.minimum_target_gain: Project feasibility criterion: ten percentage points means at least one additional correct diversion per ten target requests; pilot target-role resolution and SD are reported. This is not an enterprise SLA or measured savings threshold.
margin_rationale.minimum_useful_coverage: At least three quarters of all assigned cases should meet gain and harm jointly; independent-lineage confidence limits prevent a six-lineage confirmation claim.

multiplicity: One prespecified primary soft-vs-overlay recognition target contrast with protected-harm condition; every other arm/case/domain comparison is descriptive, with no familywise confirmatory discovery claim
official_test_use: No test parsing until every main candidate and task is sealed and a global seal ledger is hashed

planned_sample_size.claim_limit: Pilot selection reuses development/calibration and has only three independent lineages; main estimates do not satisfy a confirmatory success gate
planned_sample_size.coverage_bound_formula: Two-sided exact binomial lower bound for n/n successes is .025**(1/n); n is independent full lineage, never request rows or cases
planned_sample_size.designation: resource-capped estimation; insufficient independent lineages for the coverage criterion even if every lineage succeeds
planned_sample_size.normal_approximation_formula: ceil(((z_.975 + z_.80) * paired lineage SD / effect margin)^2); not a finite-n power guarantee
planned_sample_size.pilot_variance_scope: Three independent full encoder/head training lineages; shared fixed requests, selection-reused development diagnostics
planned_sample_size.primary_contrast: soft retention minus unchanged-intent overlay on recognition repairs, averaged within full training lineage
planned_sample_size.zero_variance_boundary: Three equal pilot outcomes cannot establish zero future variance; sensitivity floors are explicit .025 gain/.0025 harm, not observed SD

primary_contrast: soft retention minus unchanged-intent overlay on recognition repairs, averaged within full training lineage
raw_publication: No acquired raw query or image observations in repo; publish derived trained features/model arrays and source/license notices for attributed datasets
request_units: Exact normalized-text or identical-image duplicate groups; shared groups are crossed observations, semantic independence is not proved
role_assignment: Hash-sort whole normalized exact-duplicate groups stratified by first label, .60/.10/.10/.10/remainder train/development/target/protected/calibration; cross-label groups audited
stress: Per-digit confusion, official distinct-writer test partition, and native float32/binary64 decision/margin diagnostics; no authored image corruption claims
test_overlap_policy: Primary novel-row analysis excludes normalized exact duplicate groups seen anywhere in official training roles; full official test secondary. Exclusion keys are fixed before labels/outcomes, exact and token-set overlaps audited after sealing; no semantic near-duplicate claim
